faq.subtitle: Quick answers before you get started
faq.cta: More questions? See the full FAQ

items.a:
We don’t ask for your username, password, or access to your account.
The files you upload are processed locally in your browser, which means your data is not shared, sold, or stored on a server. Once you close the page, everything is cleared.

items.q: What do the files I’m uploading contain?
items.a:
The files basically contain a list of the usernames of the people you follow and the people who follow you. JSON is a common format used to organize information in programming.
For example, you could have a file called "fruits.json" with a list like apple, banana, and orange.

items.q: What is Meta and why do I need to request my files?
items.a:
Meta is the company behind Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp. By downloading your files directly from Meta, you get the official information from your account in a safe way.
Unlike many apps, unfollowz focuses on privacy. We don’t care about accessing your account, we just want to help you see who doesn’t follow you back.

Usually around 5 minutes. After requesting your information, Meta will send you a confirmation email and then your files, often almost instantly. In some cases it may take a bit longer. Once you receive the files, they will be available to download for 4 days. After that, they expire and you’ll need to request them again.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.meta: No login needed · Runs in your browser · Takes about 5 minutes

steps.title: Request your Instagram data from Meta
steps.description: Open your Instagram account settings and request a copy of your information from Meta. They usually prepare it pretty quickly.

steps.title: Download your followers and following files
steps.description: Once Meta sends your files, download them and look for the followers and following lists inside the folder.

steps.title: Upload the files into unfollowz
steps.description: Drop both files into unfollowz and the tool will compare the lists to show who doesn’t follow you back.

faq.subtitle: Still have questions? Here's everything you need to know.

items.q: Where can I find the files I need?
items.a:
The files are downloaded from Meta, inside the Instagram account information section.
The guide and video above show you exactly where to go and what to select.

items.q: What files do I need to upload exactly?
items.a: You need two files: one with the people you follow and another with your followers. The tool compares both lists to find who doesn’t follow you back.

items.q: Why not just log in with Instagram?
items.a:
Because many apps ask for full access to your account and then use your information without permission.
unfollowz avoids that completely by using the official files that Meta lets you download.

items.q: What happens if I upload the wrong file?
items.a: Nothing serious. The tool just won’t be able to process it correctly. If you get an error, check the guide and make sure you uploaded the correct files.
Yes, although the experience is usually smoother on a computer, especially when downloading and uploading files.

items.q: What does unfollowz do with my files?
items.a:
The files are read directly in your browser to compare both lists. This process is technically called a set difference operation.
Your files are never sent to servers, stored, shared, or sold.

Anyone who uses Instagram. From personal accounts to businesses, creators, or pages with thousands or even millions of followers.
If you want to see who doesn’t follow you back in a simple and private way, unfollowz is for you.

Open Source means the mechanism and code behind unfollowz are public and transparent. Anyone can check how the list comparison works and verify there’s nothing hidden.
This does not mean other people can see your data or change the app on your device. Your files stay private and are only processed in your browser.

about.title: About this project
about.description:
A tool built around one simple idea.
You should be able to use your own data without giving away your account or your privacy.

vision.title: Why unfollowz exists
vision.description:
Most apps that show who doesn’t follow you back ask you to log in with Instagram. Many of them end up having full access to your account, messages, or personal information.
unfollowz was created as a simple alternative: only using the data that Meta already lets you officially download.

privacy.title: My view on privacy
privacy.description:
I believe you should be able to use tools on the internet without giving away your password or blindly trusting third-party apps.
Your data belongs to you. That’s why unfollowz runs completely in your browser and doesn’t need servers to process your information.

opensource.title: Open Source and transparency
opensource.description:
The project is Open Source because I want anyone to be able to review how it works.
There’s no hidden logic, weird tracking, or things happening in the background. If a tool handles personal data, it should be transparent about what it does.

simple.title: Keeping it simple
simple.description:
unfollowz is not trying to be a social network, a platform, or an app full of features.
It does one thing: compare lists to show who doesn’t follow you back.

developer.title: About the developer
developer.description:
My name is Natanael, I’m from Argentina and I’m a software engineer.
I created unfollowz as a simple, transparent project focused on privacy. I enjoy building useful tools that are easy to understand and respect people’s data.
